intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in American Canyon for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 30 (the wooden bead wreath take and make craft kit) through December 12 (Saturday Crafternoons Christmas wreaths), with the Magic of the Season Holiday Marketplace and Tree Lighting (December 4) and the 16th Annual Reindeer Run (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in American Canyon
